'''Mrs. Sigurd''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[moisture farmer]] and the neighbor of [[Ariq Joanson]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She opposed Joanson's plan to make peace with [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tuskens]], because once a Tusken threw a [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaffi stick]] that lodged in a rear stabilizer when she was driving into [[Mos Eisley]].
